device.basis: GFX 50R 3.11 display control bit-16 handshake polled by 0xcf6adc. A falling request completes after the declared frame period; the delay is not measured.

GFX 50R 3.11 display control bit-16 handshake polled by 0xcf6adc. A falling request completes after the declared frame period; the delay is not measured. GFX 50R 3.11 configuration copy 0xcfc644 writes 0xfff66000, +0x4, +0x20 and +0xc8; the words read back their last write. Routine 0xcfd224 sets bit 28 of +0x2000 (0xfff66000) and polls until it reads clear, the same request as X-T20 2.11 0xca9df0; it is declared to complete at once, not measured. Scanout: emulated GFX 50R 3.11 at 700M instructions holds the X-T20 output 1 layout here: video format 0x333 at +0x010, size 0x3ff02ff (1024 x 768) at +0x02c, buffer +0x030, OSD layer 0 enabled at +0x200 with size +0x220 and buffer +0x230. Captured as host output 0; the period is a declared capture rate, not panel timing.
device.frame_basis: GFX 50R 3.11 timing banks at 0xfff5a000 and 0xfff65000; GIC routes from interrupt table 0xfb93ac rows 0x4c-0x4e and 0x49-0x4b. Frame period 16666 and stop delay 16 are declared guest ticks, not measured camera timing.

device.basis: GFX 50R 3.11 frame sync: the X-T20 law, except bit 0 of +0x00. 0xc8a530 clears it and 0x1a15668 polls it about eleven times through 0xc8a4f8; still clear, it returns 0x86 and 0x1b57db4 restarts the SETUP to REC sequence. The camera reaches REC, so the bit reads set again at once. Not measured: FF80 reads of 0xfff38000 hang the camera (lab/gfx50r-sd-blink/runs/gfx50r-frame-sync-1).

board.dram_basis: Declared discovery input: synthetic 1 GiB physical backing; RAM population is not measured. The shared XPP uncached alias is selected separately.

adc_input.basis: Measured GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff +0x188 channels 0-9, read through the resident service; channels 10-11 are declared 512, not measured.

battery_gauge.basis: Measured from the camera at RAM 0x10e79cc (run gfx50r-gauge-block-1), register 0 only. The other words in that block are not mapped to gauge registers and stay undeclared.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.

nor.basis: Declared discovery input: a Micron NOR on chip select 0 with 256-byte pages and its datasheet configuration reset 0xff. The chip part and all latencies are not measured; the ticks are synthetic.

gpio_input.basis: Measured: the sixteen GPIO input words in the GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff +0x00..+0x3c (2026-10-30), read with the USB cable attached. Bank 1 bit 14 (VBUS, declared in usb_cable) is cleared from the measured 0x5230 to 0x1230 because the emulated cable is disconnected; every other word is as measured.

pll_input.basis: Declared loader-inherited PLL state for kernel-entry discovery: PLLs 0 and 3 running, like the shared XPP stage-2 configuration. This is an assumed input, not a GFX 50R measurement; ROM execution may reprogram the clock bank.

sd_card.basis: Declared 4 GiB SDHC card for ROM-to-SD execution; size, RCA and FAT32 geometry are synthetic.

loader_handoff.basis: Measured: the first 0x5c0 bytes of the GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff at 0x7f738, read over the resident service after a normal power-on with the USB cable attached (2026-10-30, lab/gfx50r-sd-blink/runs/gfx50r-handoff-1). +0x140 is 0x10 (boot reason 2). Words +0x00..+0x3c are the sixteen GPIO bank inputs; bank 1 (+0x04) is declared 0x1230, the measured 0x5230 with bit 14 (VBUS) cleared for the disconnected emulated cable.

sub_cpu.basis: Measured GFX 50R 3.11 loader handoff +0x140 value 0x10, read through the resident service; selects boot reason 2. Registers 0x50-0x5f hold the settings header that 0xd317c0 validates, the X-T20 0xcdd670 code; a selected user profile places its header there (profile_header). Other peer registers are declared zero.

clock.basis: Declared input, the X-T20 calendar law: GFX 50R reader 0xcbd340, setter 0xcbd3a8 and converter 0xcc31e0 match X-T20 0xc70058, 0xc700c0 and 0xc75800. Seconds since 2000-01-01 in registers 0x41..0x44, run/hold at 0x45. Not measured on the camera; 846555480 is 2026-10-29 02:18.

usb_cable.basis: Declared disconnected high-speed USB input; VBUS bank 1 bit 14 is assumed from the shared controller wiring, not measured.

storage_slots.basis: GFX 50R specifications: two SD card slots (UHS-II).
GFX 50R specifications: two SD card slots (UHS-II).
